text.description_html:
Field Enterprises RPS-220, Solid Brass 2 Inch Square Ring Pull

While the 2 Inch Square Ring Pull is designed to be used on lightweight doors such as on closets and cabinets, we think that it would be just as perfect as a pull on dresser drawers. The square shape is quintessentially modern in appearance, and the Solid Brass 2 Inch Square Ring Pull will be perfect to imbued a contemporary feel to furniture especially in either the polished chrome or polished nickel finishes. However, this Modern 2 Inch Square Furniture Ring Pull is available in 5 finishes in total.

Also Available: Larger Modern 3" Square Furniture Ring Pull

Specifications and Features of the Square RPS220 Ring Pull:

  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Overall Length: 2" square
  • Grip: 3/8" square
  • Grip Cutout: 1-11-32"
  • Projection: 7/8"
  • Mount Length: 1/2" square
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
